value.rationale: The number 599 is not an artificial cutoff: the motivating paper uses n<=599 for finite checking before analytic incompleteness takes over. Exact mEC(n) is explicitly named as an open optimization problem; completing all 592 cases at the natural cutoff with one chord supplies a nontrivial full finite classification and a reproducible witness table. It neither claims an all-parameter theorem nor invents downstream applications.
